method: Diagnostic extraction of a sufficient selected-domain assumption core, not a packing retry. Gate each selected domain bound/halfplane by its own assumption selector; gate every original mutual separation piece by both relevant selectors. Unselected parts have free global anchors and no active pair conditions, which is a relaxation used only to explain infeasibility. Retain all original inequalities and every exact bounds-filtering proof from the independently audited coordinate model. Prove the entire transformed protobuf is exactly this conditional relaxation, including all9 initial assumptions, before one10-second/single-worker/seed-zero call. Any returned core is solver-derived and is not an independent mathematical unsatisfiability certificate; a future model may use the verified source-model negative/full tuple, while a smaller core requires its own direct validation. No partial layout, native acceptance or H5 claim.
